note: Evil Mode slice 22: the nine Charters and the Turn (design Part 28). Text from Part 28 sections 4 to 15. A Charter reads nothing but this file; the Turn reads only the run it's in.
tabLine: Nine teams somebody else built. Every page is printed, the trouble on day three included. Nothing about a Charter is hidden, and none is better than founding a team.

turn.title: The Turn
fields: Carry on as the Boss. From the next region, this run's an Evil Mode run.
Gyms, the League and your rivals will treat you as the Boss of this team. Stages become days. You'll send people, and go yourself.
Your party, your bag, your Blessings, your level cap, your four rivals, and how many regions this run has left.
All of it, in this run. The next run's a new run.
turn.walk: Take it all, and walk away.
turn.confirm: Take the chair? The rest of this run is an Evil Mode run. Press again to take it.
turn.oldLookLine: Evil Mode is drawn in the New look. It's on for the rest of this run; your setting isn't changed.
turn.ledgerFirst: The inside route, as a Boss would read it.

lines.champion-chaser: "We were going to do the League. We. I've still got the route planned."
lines.strategist: "I've been trying to work out what you get. I can't make it add up. Show me the working."
lines.bitter-challenger: "I knew. I knew. ...I didn't want to be right."
lines.enthusiast: "Is it true? Somebody said, and I said no, and then I said I'd ask."
lines.idealist: "People change. That's my whole thing. I didn't think I'd have to use it on you."
lines.prodigy: "I'm faster than you now. I wanted you to see that when it was a good thing."
lines.underdog: "You were the one who said I could."

after.lie: {hero} looks at you a long time. "Okay." They don't believe it, and they go.
after.true: {hero} nods once, as if they'd been hit, and goes.
after.silent: {hero} waits. Then they go, and they don't look back until the corner.

ask.line: Asked, in person, at step {step}: {mood}. It's on the Board from now on.

plasma.who: Bronius: "The ones in the cellar. Start there."
plasma.wrong: {name}: "Somebody took what wasn't theirs and wrote a name on it."
do: We make the ones who took them give them back.
We keep them until it's safe, and we say so.
plasma.wont: The Hall, aloud: "We won't take anyone's again. Not for a cause. Not for this one."
plasma.returnLine: Returned from the cellar: one label, one Pokémon, one person at the gate. Regard +1.

twoBoards.formLine: Faba countersigns: ₽{amount} from Aether's purse to Skull's. His price isn't money: Regard {regard}.

group.held: ₽{amount} is over ₽2,000. It goes to the board; the answer comes next Morning.
group.yes: The board: yes. It makes money. ({what})
group.no: The board: no, with a memo. It doesn't make money. ({what})
group.memo: {name} writes the memo. The board signs it as whatever the Boss needs it called. ({what})

flare.unseat: {name} isn't laid for. They won't pay, and they'll mind.

charters.name: Rocket
charters.question: What's a ledger for?

patron.name: Carrow
patron.note: The clerk who kept the books and was never once in the room.

morning: The Ledger's already open. Four thousand, one hundred and twelve names.
A note from Faye, in biro, on a paper napkin: "I copied these by hand. Which d'you want to start with?"

desk.title: Friday
desk.text: The back pay. Giovanni left owing eight people three weeks: ₽600 each. The Roster's watching what happens to it.

desk.title: The Game Corner
desk.text: Still running. A Racket that pays ₽900 a day. Its Card's "Who pays for it" reads: "Pensioners, mostly."

desk.title: The Pen
desk.text: Forty-three Pokémon in the basement. Under Clean hands the doors are opened and the game doesn't ask.

rule.name: The Ledger pays back
rule.text: Any Evening, return one thing from the Ledger. It costs Carrow's valuation and pays Regard +1. It never pays Funds, and never cools Heat.

oldGuard.name: Proton
oldGuard.text: He'll pay the back wages himself, ₽700 a head, to anyone who crosses by Friday.
oldGuard.turnLine: Proton: "You fetched his coffee for a month. I watched you do it. I'm to call you what?"

charters.dayThree: The Game Corner's manager asks whether to carry on.

charters.name: Rocket's Return
charters.question: Who were they waiting for?

patron.name: Sabela
patron.note: Called the roll for three years to an empty chair.

morning: A hundred and fifty people, at roll call. Sabela reads every name. Then: "The Boss."
A silence. It's three years long. Sabela, to you, not unkindly: "...Present?"

desk.title: The transmitter
desk.text: Mahogany. It's still on. Switching it off is free and takes a person a day. Nobody's been told they're allowed.

desk.title: The Well
desk.text: Azalea. A rope, a ladder, and a stock of tails in a cold room. Its Card's "The other way" reads: "Don't."

desk.title: The broadcast
desk.text: Archer booked the Radio Tower for the seventh day. Four minutes of air, and nobody to call home.

rule.name: The roll's called
rule.text: Every Morning the register's read, and the Boss answers it or doesn't. Seven days answered running: Loyalty +1, once a region. A missed day: the roll falls ten.

oldGuard.name: Ariana
oldGuard.text: "You're in his office. I'm not angry. I'd like you to leave it as you found it."
oldGuard.turnLine: Ariana: "You answered the roll. I heard. You weren't on it."

charters.dayThree: Tobi's told the whole Dorm the Boss said "Present." Or that the Boss didn't.
charters.figure: The roll was answered {answered} mornings of {days}.

charters.name: The Joint Command
charters.question: Can a house be two colours?

patron.name: Ottoway
patron.note: Bunked with recruits and trained six cohorts for a flood.

morning: Two messages, an hour apart. The blue side: "Don't trust the Magma lot. They'd have dried the sea." The red: "Don't trust the Aqua lot. They'd have drowned the land."
Ottoway: "I've trained both. I'm on the side of whoever's turn it is to wash up."

desk.title: The rota
desk.text: Who cooks. Who's on the dock. It's been drawn up twice.

desk.title: The Orbs
desk.text: Both, in one safe. Mt. Pyre's old couple have written, politely, twice.

desk.title: The submarine
desk.text: Half-built. Greer has the plans. Lior has the keys. Neither's spoken to the other since the merger.

rule.name: One of each
rule.text: Everyone's red or blue. Loyalty's kept twice, and the team's is the lower. The name's put to the Hall once both reach 6.

oldGuard.name: Shelly and Courtney
oldGuard.text: "We're not your enemy. We're your future, if you do it right, or your warning, if you don't."
oldGuard.turnLine: Shelly: "I told Archie you were trouble. I was right, and I backed the wrong trouble."

charters.dayThree: A fight in the corridor, over the bare strip. It's about a mop.
charters.limits: The Cause Creed is limited, so the Joint Command uses Power; Ember's half isn't drawn.

charters.name: Galactic
charters.question: Has anybody asked?

patron.name: Wren Halvard
patron.note: The technician who took her helmet off.

morning: A clipboard. Saturn, who's stayed, because somebody had to hand over: "I'll need a title for you. For the log."
The Board's all green. Every job's on time. Nobody in Galactic ever asked.

desk.title: The lakes
desk.text: Three vans are booked. The signature's Cyrus's, and it's still valid.

desk.title: Two hundred haircuts
desk.text: The barber's on the payroll. Wren's asked whether it's still compulsory.

desk.title: The Canteen
desk.text: Everybody eats at once, in rows, in eleven minutes, in silence.

rule.name: Nobody's ever asked
rule.text: A local's mood is unknown until somebody goes and asks, in person.

oldGuard.name: Charon
oldGuard.text: "A new world. Honestly. Has anyone here asked what the old one's worth, per acre?"
oldGuard.turnLine: Charon: "The recruit! The one who asked questions. I said to Cyrus, that one'll cost us."

charters.dayThree: A Grunt laughs in the Canteen. Once. The room stops.
charters.limits: Moods are '?' until asked and jobs roll as Easy before; the Roster's blank lines are as on any team.

charters.name: Plasma
charters.question: What are we counting?

patron.name: Bronius
patron.note: A Vigil Knight who counted candles.

morning: Six hundred candles and three hundred people with their hands in their pockets.
Bronius: "I count. Six hundred, every night, for a king. What am I counting, under you?"

desk.title: The castle's rooms
desk.text: The Pokémon that were "freed". Every label has a person's name on it.

desk.title: The speech
desk.text: Booked, in Accumula. Somebody has to say something, or cancel.

desk.title: N's room
desk.text: The door's shut. There's a train set. Nobody's been in.

rule.name: The sentence gets written
rule.text: The Cause sentence is written in play, one part at a time, each put forward by somebody on the Roster.

oldGuard.name: Ghetsis
oldGuard.text: N writes: "You have my room. You may have it. Please don't move the trains."
oldGuard.turnLine: Ghetsis: "You knelt. I remember everyone who knelt. I remember it differently now."

charters.dayThree: The first person comes to the gate for their Pokémon, with a receipt.
charters.limits: The sentence is written in play and gates the takings; the Cause Creed itself is limited, so Plasma uses Belonging.

charters.name: Flare
charters.question: Who's the table for?

patron.name: Yarborough
patron.note: The concierge who laid the tables.

morning: Yarborough, with a tray: "Will there be a table, under the new management? I ask only to know how many to lay."

desk.title: The dues
desk.text: Six members' subscriptions fall due. They're the team's whole income.

desk.title: The list
desk.text: Who was to be saved. It's in the safe.

desk.title: The café
desk.text: A Front, lovely, and in profit.

rule.name: Members, not staff
rule.text: Members pay ₽400 every seven days, at the Evening.

oldGuard.name: Xerosic
oldGuard.text: "The chief's finished? Then it's a free experiment."
oldGuard.turnLine: Xerosic: "You were on the list! Did you know? Row nine. I'd have missed you."

charters.dayThree: The list's found by a Grunt who isn't on it.
charters.limits: Members can be seated or not; seats for guests, the table's length and member-or-staff hiring aren't played.

charters.name: The Two Boards
charters.question: Who's doing the cooking?

patron.name: Iolana
patron.note: Tupp's aunt, who cooked for Skull before Plumeria did.

morning: Two Boards. One's a glass wall with every figure in the right column. One's plywood, rained on, with a drawing of a Wimpod.
Plumeria, with a ladle: "Who's doin' the cookin'?"

desk.title: The lower floors
desk.text: Aether's. Locked. Faba's got the card.

desk.title: The roof
desk.text: Po Town's. It leaks on eleven beds. Aether's got ₽9,000 and a form.

desk.title: The Trials
desk.text: Six of the house are of age and never took theirs.

rule.name: Two purses
rule.text: Skull's got ₽300. Aether's got ₽9,000, behind a form.

oldGuard.name: Lusamine
oldGuard.text: "You were never one of my treasures, dear. You were packaging."
oldGuard.turnLine: Lusamine: "The little helper. You carried trays. One doesn't negotiate with the tray."

charters.dayThree: Guzma's sent on his first job. Hala's on the route.
charters.limits: Aether's ₽9,000 is its own purse, moved by Faba's form; jobs and rooms spend Skull's, and the Kitchen vote isn't played.

charters.name: The Group
charters.question: Who signed for this?
morning: Eight subsidiaries, each a column. And one that's a single line with no name, and a very large number.
A coach in the car park, engine running, twenty people in pink and black with horns.

desk.title: The eighth column
desk.text: The plant under Hammerlocke. Mr. Pettigrew's stopped sleeping.

desk.title: The coach
desk.text: Yell. They want a fixture list.

desk.title: The gap
desk.text: Spikemuth. No signal, no subsidiary, no column.

rule.name: It needs a signature
rule.text: The ₽20,000 is the Group's. A spend over ₽2,000 goes to the board.

oldGuard.name: The Chairman
oldGuard.text: By courier, with a seed packet: "I gather you've found the eighth column. Do water it."
oldGuard.turnLine: Oleana: "He asked me to say he always thought you'd go far. He asked me not to say how far."

charters.dayThree: Mr. Pettigrew puts the eighth column's file on the desk and doesn't sit down.
charters.limits: Spends over ₽2,000 go to the board and the Books memo works; dissolving columns isn't played.

charters.name: The Staff Room
charters.question: Where were the adults?

patron.name: Yusuf
patron.note: The retired caretaker who watched a team form.

morning: A timetable, pinned to the Board. Third period: Battle Studies. Teacher: —
Yusuf: "They've asked for you. It came under the door, on squared paper. I'd go. I'd take chalk."

desk.title: Third period
desk.text: The lesson. A class of forty.

desk.title: The folder
desk.text: The record of what was done and who signed it off.

desk.title: The cooking pot
desk.text: Mela's crew haven't got a decent one. ₽180.

rule.name: The register
rule.text: Take and Lean were never offered. Heat stops at 3. Dread stays 0. The Line can't be moved.

oldGuard.name: Nobody
oldGuard.text: Nobody betrayed Star. Penny, with the voice changer off: "So you're staff now. ...Mela says you can stay. I'm still deciding."
oldGuard.turnLine: Penny: "So you're staff now. ...Mela says you can stay. I'm still deciding."

charters.dayThree: Ortega's parents ring to complain that a member of staff's been seen carrying a car door.
